title: RAW INCOMPLETE: crossed preservation of free bench and tall-body motifs in embedded working signs
summary: A graphical construction hypothesis: a scribe optionally combines a low bench-like body with a tall-body motif. Compare independently specified features of free exemplars with embedded specimens and wrong-family distractors. No selected image packet, fixed overlap rule or linguistic expansion yet; preserve as unreviewed raw queue, not an executed or ready test.

design.title: Crossed graphical component-preservation observation for an embedded height-family sign
design.mechanism: A writer optionally combines a reusable bench-like motif with a reusable tall-body motif. Their visual co-presence is a physical construction claim; expanded source-letter identity is a separate stronger claim.
design.distinguishing_prediction: Identify diagnostic bench and height-family features from free exemplars before examining fixed embedded targets. Predict both feature bundles in embedded forms; include a wrong-height-family distractor. Use predefined missing/uncertain outcomes, not free pixel deformation until every target fits. A shared fusion rule across a second withheld height family is more informative than inspecting one symbol already named cHh.
design.smallest_selection_requirement: Root must identify an admitted source-bound set of free bench, free height, embedded target and contrasting height exemplar, ideally same hand/line. This bounded producer did not establish such a specimen packet and did not acquire images or query native strings to manufacture it.
design.controls: Separate physical component identification from transcription labels; preserve wrong-component alternatives and whole-sign mimicry. No automated segmentation or template-fitting pipeline before specimen and discriminating-feature adequacy.
limitations: Static ink cannot determine stroke order, pen lifts, BH versus HB chronology or phoneme order.
A complex single letter can reuse graphical components; positive geometry does not prove two linguistic units or equal meanings between expanded/fused words.
Exact overlap/shared-stroke rule and feature scoring need a physically motivated contract before testing. Unspecified overlap allowance would make the claim unfalsifiable.
Not a proposal to retry old connected-arch vowel or gap conditions.

source_free_feature_suggestions.bench: From independently selected free exemplars, record whether two distinguishable low supporting bodies lie left/right of a connecting roof or bridge; record their relative baseline and the bridge attachment pattern. These are candidate descriptive slots, not guaranteed native observations. If free exemplars do not exhibit a stable feature, do not invent it for the target.
source_free_feature_suggestions.tall_body: From free exemplars, freeze a small qualitative bundle: number of tall stems; whether the upper part has an open branch or a closed loop; side and attachment of any return or cross-stroke relative to the stem. Choose only features actually stable and visible in the free exemplars. Do not use EVA character names as evidence.
source_free_feature_suggestions.allowed_overlap: A proposed restrictive rule permits translation, common uniform scale and local coincidence/interruption only where the tall stem crosses or joins the bench bridge. Both low supports and the diagnostic upper tall-body feature must remain independently visible outside that junction. No arbitrary deletion of a support, cap loop or branch, no per-component warping and no added feature-specific exception. This suggested rule is not yet a registered physical model and may be unsuitable once free exemplars are inspected.
source_free_feature_suggestions.decision_labels: For each frozen feature: preserved / incompatible / unresolved. A missing feature due to low resolution or ink damage is unresolved, not absent. No target-selected crop, feature substitution or revised overlap allowance after target viewing.
source_free_feature_suggestions.crossed_contrast: A matching tall-family diagnostic should remain in the embedded specimen while the wrong-family diagnostic should not fit under the same rule. Bench evidence should be separately recognizable. If both tall alternatives fit, report nonidentifying; if neither fits, reject the proposed literal component-preservation rule or mark unresolved as specified prospectively.
source_free_feature_suggestions.minimum_packet: Root must bind actual admitted free-bench, free-height, embedded and alternative-height specimens to exact image rectangles and cached reader labels before any target view. A second family can test transfer only if nominated prospectively; do not choose it after a favorable first result.

claim_limits: Physical feature reuse only; not two source letters, syllable units, phonemes, meanings or optional equivalence of whole words.
A unitary complex sign may reuse graphic strokes; a positive comparison does not distinguish that from a ligature by itself.
No stroke chronology, BH/HB order, pen lift or causal motor program inferred from static ink.
Preserve1307 compulsory-fusion failures,1333 no residual word/site gain,1310 conditional aliases and1311/1244 unresolved atomicity.
A negative under one overlap rule does not reject every possible scribal fusion; no automatic repair follows.
prior_checks: Live route and composition topic; required1310/11,1320/1333,1243 primary/followups; bounded ligature,ductus,superposition,graphical-primitives,bench searches and fusion route-check. No claim exhaustive. Candidate stays incomplete instead of being represented as a ready experiment.
ownership: Root owns source/selector/image admission and test selection. Producer used no target image or new native payload. RAW retention is not admission.
